FULL TEXT:
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Advertisement for Project Fellow Under RUSA 2.0, UGC Scheme
Applications are invited from already enrolled PhD students of Panjab University,
Chandigarh for the position of Project Fellow under RUSA 2.0 in the following thrust areas
Sr.
no.
Thrust Area Number of Project fellow posts
available
1 Social sciences and applied fields 5
2 Physical Sciences 5
3 Biological Sciences(life Sciences) 5
4 Engineering Sciences 5
5 Chemical Sciences 5
Eligibility:
(i) The candidate to be considered for appointment as Project Fellow must have master’s degree
with a minimum of 55% marks for general category (50% in case of SC/ST/OBC/PH).
(ii) The upper age limit for applicants is 40 years.
(iii) The Project Fellow should do work full time in the project and get the fellowship from one
source only.
Duration:The position of project fellow will be initially for a period of nine months and can
be extended on the basis of performanceand as per availability of funds in RUSA 2.0 scheme.
Fellowship: Rs. 25,000/- per month (consolidated)
Eligible candidates are required to submit soft copy of their application form along with
educational qualification documents, list of publications, detailed CV and 1500 words brief
research proposal in above mentioned thrust areas by e-mail to the coordinator RUSA 2.0
Panjab University with the subject “application for Project Fellow with specified Thrust area”.
(Application form and research proposal format is attached below)
Email ID – pu_rusa@pu.ac.in
Last Date of submission – 20th May 2025 by 2:00 PM
General Instruction to Applicants
1. The prescribed essential qualification indicated are bare minimum, and mere possessions
of same will not entitle applicants to be offered the Fellowship. Therefore, applicants
should furnish details of all qualifications possessed in the relevant field and show the
documentary evidences at the time of interviews.
2. The institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all of the advertised Fellowships.
3. Incomplete application will not be considered.

DECLARATION
I hereby declare that I have carefully read the instructions and particulars supplied to me and
that the entries made in this application form are correct to the best of my knowledge and belief.
If selected, I promise to abide by the rules and discipline of the Institute.
I note that the decision of RUSA, Panjab University is final in regard to selection. RUSA,
Panjab University shall have the right to take necessary action at any time after my selection,
provided it is found that I was admitted on false particulars furnished by me or my antecedents
prove that my continuance in the Project is not desirable. I agree that I shall abide by the
decision of RUSA, Panjab University, which shall be final.
